title: Quiz
description: Turn this form into a quiz — score responses and control what respondents see

enable.title: Enable quiz mode
enable.description: Grade responses and show results using each field's answer key

disableConfirm: Turning off quiz mode keeps every answer key you've set on your fields — they're just ignored until you turn it back on. Continue?
keysPreservedNotice: Answer keys are never deleted from this panel. Turning quiz mode off only stops grading — your fields keep their answer keys for whenever you turn it back on.

passThreshold.label: Pass threshold
passThreshold.help: Minimum percentage score required to pass

gradeRelease.label: Grade release
gradeRelease.immediateDescription: Respondents see their grade right after submitting
gradeRelease.afterReviewDescription: Grades are held until you release them
gradeRelease.scheduledDescription: Grades are released automatically at a date and time you choose
gradeRelease.identityRequiredHint: "After manual review" and "At a scheduled time" need a way to reach the respondent later. Turn on sign-in (Access Control) or respondent email collection to unlock them.

releaseAt.label: Release at
releaseAt.required: Choose a release date and time to save a scheduled grade release

visibility.title: What respondents can see
visibility.description: Each of these is independent — turn on only what you want to share

perQuestionCorrectness.title: Per-question correctness
perQuestionCorrectness.description: Whether each answer was right or wrong

correctAnswers.title: Correct answers
correctAnswers.description: The accepted answer for each question

pointValues.title: Point values
pointValues.description: How many points each question was worth

passFailBadge.title: Pass/fail badge
passFailBadge.description: Whether the respondent passed or failed

gradeReleaseDowngraded.title: Grade release changed to Immediate
gradeReleaseDowngraded.description: "After manual review" and "At a scheduled time" need a way to reach the respondent later, so turning off sign-in or email collection also switched grade release back to Immediate.
